metadata.oracle: 1.0*k_eff, log[:,26], at the current tick from a shadow tick on copied state; sigma=chi=0; CENTRE off; k_bar keeps its downward rate limit (rho_d). Diagnostic, not a ranked algorithm.
metadata.frozen: Configurations from baseline_test_r2 selected on development scenes before the H correction, not retuned. Xue first-contact position calibrated per scene as in baseline_compare.
metadata.own_mechanism: Rossi-ID, Kalman, MHE, Xue-const, Simple-1, Simple-2, Huber-D4_nogate, Huber-D4_imm, D4_nogate, D4_imm, kal_long, kal_short, lepski, ewa, forget_time, ard_fixed: CC.own_mechanism; no acceptance gates, phase sigma gate, feed-forward jump rule or CENTRE. _imm adds unchanged R.make_filter(imm). Huber-D4, D4 and P5 keep their gates.
metadata.xue_chi: Dropped: its only difference from Xue-const was a residual gate this project added; a separately selected configuration is not a different method.
metadata.ideal_cal: Huber-D4_idealcal, oracle_keff_idealcal: same scenes with exact mass, force offset and servo lag in the sensing stage, a diagnostic, not a plausible calibration.
metadata.execution_scope_deviation: Six additional A_large oracle_keff_on runs were mistakenly executed while extending the old gate-equivalence check. They are outside the requested Table 1 scope and excluded from rows/tables; old 36 oracle_keff_on rows are preserved. The runner now limits new old-method runs to Table 1 methods.
